steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: So you're here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Manfred?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It seems the Sanguinarch will be greatly disappointed. He detests dark, damp places the most, yet went into the rebels' subterranean nest to seize you personally.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: He must surely have caught up to your friends by now. One wonders if the cries from underground will carry so far up this tower—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You wicked... wicked...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Wicked devil?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No, I don't admire his methods whatsoever. The rebels who died to my cannon fire are far luckier than the ones suffering his torment.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You're both just the same!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: In your eyes, maybe so. Whenever you use 'devil' and such to refer to us all, it shows that fear and hatred have long clouded your eyes.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The Victorians regard the Sarkaz as a collective of barbarians reveling in slaughter.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Those who thought like that are now either kneeling before the throne, or are now pale skeletons dried upon the city walls.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You, and Theresis... the army you've led has devastated this city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter how you claim you and the vampire are different, you're both invaders here, hands dripping with blood.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You seem to misunderstand, Cautus of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I'm not solely drawing lines between myself and the Prince of Blood—yes, in a certain respect, his predilections disgust me.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But I, like him, do not work the way all the kings of the Court do.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: When they stand in front of you, they see Her Majesty's successor, and they may treat you with skepticism, curiosity or disgust for it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can only feel vigilance from you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Yes, Cautus. I simply see you—as a dangerous enemy.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: —Did he just toss a grenade at us?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hold onto the wall!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's his Arts... he's using Arts energy to make shockwaves, he's trying to throw us off the city!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ugh... can't stand straight—it's like every part of the ground's erupting...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The drones can't get near him! Any closer at all and they lose balance—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone... get behind me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hrrgh––

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A—Amiya, are his Arts fusing with yours?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He's deliberately narrowed and sharpened his attack. He's breaking down the energy layers I form...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What?! You were able to resist a Draco's flames, though!

options: He's familiar with our combat style.
His Arts are targeted at Amiya.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I knew full well you'd come. You think I'd just sit here waiting for you?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: There—There goes another one! It's not just the ground, it's, it's above us, wherever red flashes by, it explodes in midair—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Miss Amiya, can't... can't you use mental Arts?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Can you try and just cram his head with some kind of rubbish?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He's too well-defended, and he's too calm. I can feel the edges of his emotions, but... but right now, his heart only thirsts for victory.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes... his mind isn't set on this battle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He's just waiting for the vampire and defense artillery to destroy the resistance!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Stalling for time? Decent conjecture.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: {@nickname}, I've always been more intrigued by you than that Cautus who lucked into the power of the King.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You've faced graver circumstances than this on the battlefield—the choices you make always seem to be the ones more beneficial to the whole.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Please, tell me, what are you about to do next?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Will you expend all your efforts here to kill me and eliminate a long-term threat, or think of some other way to get around me and save those Victorians below?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Uwaaagh!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Mr. Balin, what's happening up ahead?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Partial collapse in the passageway! Three fighters couldn't escape in time—

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Route around it! We're pressing on.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Remember, no matter who we lose on this journey, the rest of us cannot stop.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Up, quick, do you see that train?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: The Sarkaz haven't found us yet, from the looks of it. Let's think of a way to blend in there, and grab the controls—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Harmo, watch out!!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Sarkaz Crossbowman! They've ambushed us!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Rockrock, one step out and we'll get hit! Best we run back underground!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Going back's... riskier still.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The Commander says our only chance is to get the train moving before the Sarkaz destroy the space underground.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: But Harmo...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain Harmo gave his life.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I'm in charge now.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Listen. We have to start the train immediately after we interrupt their shelling.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: If I fall, then it's down to the next one—even if just one man's left in the end, we have to get him out of here!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I think this door's almost a lost cause, isn't it?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Commander, we'll hold them off!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't. You can't.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Ha, ha... you think we don't know that, Rhodes Islander?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Men of the 13th, with me!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey, you're running backwards! Don't be daft—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: The—The door's down!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Shoot, shoot! Blow 'em up! Everyone go! We're taking that monster down with us!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Ugh... uaargh—!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: He's... here.
The smoke clears, and a figure emerges from the end of the jet-black tunnel.
This monster brandishes no claws, has no twisted limbs, bears no sharp fangs nor keen incisors, nor grows any extraneous feelers.
He seems like nothing more than a young noble whose picture could be in the papers, one who'd speak frankly about Londinium's political and economical situation.
If only... the ground below his feet was not soaked in fresh blood.
What a terrible smell. Your men fight rather too dirty.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Monster...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Don't... Don't you think of getting near the commander...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: M—My hand? Nothing even touched—agh!
Hah... now, this scent's much cozier.
I wouldn't mind... using the only thing of worth in your bodies to give the floor a wash.
The vampire airily lifts a finger, as if holding up a crystal chalice, or following the pulse of a piece of music.
The shadows leap up from beneath him, latching onto the soldiers' bodies, winding about their limbs.
What chilling screams follow are drowned entirely under the liquid that bursts forth.
The concentrated iron reek boring into nasal cavities. Bright red overflowing wherever one looks.
This is the instant the people stood at the tunnel's other end realize...
What chased them was no shadow at all. It was running blood, as thick as could be.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Is this... how Warfarin and Closure used to look?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: That's the first thing that pops into your mind?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Well, what the hell do you want me to think? It's better than being stark terrified, innit?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Run! Run like hell!
Where is the 'King of Sarkaz?'

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: What are you—
I come so far, go to all this trouble for an audience with her, and she cowers behind you frail little creatures, not even daring to meet me?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Agh—!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Amiya.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: He's here for Amiya.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You mean that King whatever he said? You're sure that's Amiya? Isn't Amiya a Cautus?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Forget it, it's not important.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But Amiya's not here...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's good.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Um, fair. Even she might not cope best with this monster of a thing.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Wonder if her and the Doctor've almost won... *sigh* What am I thinking? Even if they can shut the city artillery down, we're about to be torn to scraps here.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, what's our plan?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Run.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I don't want to... and I CAN'T die here.

a.text: Run into the darkness before you. Don't think.
These tunnels will take you anywhere you wish to go.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can't keep this deadlock up anymore.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, step back.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm going to condense stronger energy. I have to defeat Manfred as quickly as possible.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, please trust me. I've matured a lot since the last time I removed my inhibitors.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I knew I wouldn't let myself fall, just as we entered Londinium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh... his energy is densifying! It's like... like a net, from head, to toe... it's everywhere!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The air's... full of invisible Originium crystals! He's scattering them as beacons for his attacks!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No wonder! It's like invisible drones are throwing bombs all about!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Feist, you and Closure have to get away... if you get caught up, there'll be nowhere to hide!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You can use more strength than that, Cautus.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm forcing my Arts... against this energy flow...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Savor it. I formed this cage myself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Am I less able to shake it... the more I struggle?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Cautus, you said my mind wasn't set on this battle with you. You were only half correct.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I'll deliver you bound before Her Majesty. The Sarkaz in Londinium... are loath to see an outblood flaunting her borrowed power from the King.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't, and I don't want to command them.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Of course you can't.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But they shouldn't be commanded by Theresis either.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When I stayed in Kazdel, I saw so many Sarkaz warriors. Plenty of them were mercenaries. After that, at Chernobog... I met them again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even when they were being exploited by Talulah, at least they knew who their enemy in each battle was, and knew they were giving up their lives for a future.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But now? You've trapped them inside a foreign city. Ever since the moment I came, I've sensed their frustration, their anxiety, their bewilderment...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You read my warriors' emotions?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The net's... tightening? Are you angry?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Cautus, has anyone ever told you you're too conceited? You're no more than an Infected. You've never experienced for yourself what truly constitutes a Sarkaz life.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You simply sit on the side and watch. What makes you think you can truly comprehend our pain, our resentment?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's true, I might not be able to comprehend.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... the fire that blazes in your hearts, it's burned since the distant past into the present, from the first razing of Kazdel to today in Londinium, and even now, it's still within me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It burns. It burns incomparably true, truer than any illusion that words or Arts could conjure.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Say your piece as you please, Infected.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I know how this power of yours originates.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Once a lie is spun, it will not be any less of a lie, no matter how convinced the liar is of it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sarkaz, Infected...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter how you identify each one of us, we're all just ordinary people wanting to live through the unjust circumstances we're put in.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Theresis has brought everyone into a hopeless war—look at the Victorian dukes' armies outside the city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All it takes is for them to point their lances the same way—it could be Kazdel, it could be Londinium, but all that awaits the Sarkaz then is ruin.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter what you're using to spur them on—bloodlines, authority, renown... it's those that are the total lies!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: When did you reform your energy and make some scant space?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I was not wrong, Cautus.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: —You are very dangerous.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your power, your speech... It may be unable to shake our mightiest soldiers, but it certainly brings our enemies the delusion of hope. I don't want them struggling any further.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You have no choice but to stop here. I won't ever let you enter this city again—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I will crush flat this cage of yours!
Cage? I'm not even sure it lives up to that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Someone's altering the density of my Arts?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Wait, it's you again...

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Doctor, am I a little late here?

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Finding a route through Londinium's city walls, well... that's tough, even for me.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Lucky I found a few outstanding helpers.
Minutes before...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor, I've locked onto Manfred.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Uh, barely anybody's with him...

options: He's not scared of us approaching him.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You think he's overpowered? He looks like he eats fights for breakfast. Maybe Theresis taught him a bunch of moves.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Can we seriously pound him into stopping the artillery like a good boy with just five minutes?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No, scratch that, no I in this we. At this point, you can't count me and Feist as part of your combat force. Throwing Logistics guys into this fray'd be a hell of a way to waste lives.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya, you're all we've got...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Manfred is a powerful enemy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we've faced powerful enemies to come all this way... and we'll surely face more still.

options: Amiya, you keep all of Manfred's attention.
Closure, Feist, ready our retreat from the tower.
The one we're waiting for is almost here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Reprising old tricks? Did you really think I'd let you all escape a second time?
A thread of energy comes rushing in, as if it's locked onto some position in the air.
You almost feel the point of that sword slice at the tip of your feet.
Until a shield comes down in front of you all.
Drop any thoughts of pursuing them, Sarkaz.
Your fight is right here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: White Wolf. I didn't imagine you would come face me again.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: So this passage is bidirectional, what a surprise. You sent them away, and brought yourself in at the same time?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It wasn't me... It was us.
Behind Horn, a soldier stands up.
And then a second, and then a third.
And now over a dozen Victorian soldiers block the Sarkaz general's way.
All of them, camouflages dropped.
They wear a dizzying array of different uniforms, the majority scarred in the roiling flames of war, some covered in mud and cobweb, some splattered by the blood of their own comrades.
Their weapons are just as motley, some still holding regulation swords, some instead toting self-fashioned crossbows.
But their faces all bear an identical vigor.
This time, they stand firm or fall once and for all. They will never retreat.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: A gaggle of leftover forces thinks they can beat me?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You aren't fit to fight me, even with a weapon.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Have you forgotten you owe your last escape from my grasp entirely to that Rhodes Island Sarkaz meddler?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You can stop checking all around, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: When you don't respect your opponent on the battlefield, you're the first to fall.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your blabbering may well be more stubborn than your shield.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hrrgh––

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Watch the enemy's attack angle! Assemble behind me!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I wasn't planning to eliminate you, but I didn't know you would be so eager to hold your own funeral.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Here I thought you'd have some level of tactical prowess, White Wolf.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You bring a platoon of wounded men to resist me, and have your soldiers give up their lives one after another? Is this your so-called professional spirit?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't... forget where you're stood right now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: This is the city wall of Londinium.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't go assuming you've already conquered her, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: —See for yourself.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We're still right here.
